msg: test/dev dependencies: pytest, pytest-mock, pytest-cov, pyfakefs>=5.2.4,<6
rule sheet for pydantic 1→2 from cache (348 rules)

diagnosis: The upgrade to pydantic 2.x breaks because BaseSettings was moved to the separate pydantic-settings package, causing import errors in both test files. Additionally, vault_settings.py uses several deprecated V1 APIs (__fields__, parse_obj_as, ValidationError import path, alias behavior) that have changed or been removed in V2.

steps.change: replace 'from pydantic import BaseSettings, SecretStr, ValidationError, parse_obj_as' with 'from pydantic_settings import BaseSettings'; 'from pydantic import SecretStr, ValidationError, TypeAdapter'
steps.why: BaseSettings moved to pydantic-settings; ValidationError now at top level; parse_obj_as replaced by TypeAdapter
parse_obj_as deprecated; use TypeAdapter.validate_python for non-BaseModel validation

steps.change: guard field.alias usage with 'if field.alias is not None:' since alias now returns None when not set
steps.why: V2 alias returns None instead of field name when not explicitly set

steps.change: replace 'from pydantic import BaseSettings, SecretStr' with 'from pydantic_settings import BaseSettings'; 'from pydantic import SecretStr'
steps.why: test imports removed BaseSettings from pydantic; must import from pydantic-settings

steps.change: replace 'from pydantic import BaseModel, BaseSettings, Field, SecretStr' with 'from pydantic import BaseModel, Field, SecretStr'; 'from pydantic_settings import BaseSettings'
steps.why: test imports removed BaseSettings from pydantic; must import from pydantic-settings

risks: Optional field validation logic changed to match dataclasses (R46) — may affect whether None vs missing values are treated differently
Union type validation now preserves input type when possible (R45) — may change coercion behavior for union fields
Regex engine switched to Rust crate (R47) — pattern behavior may differ for complex regex; can configure regex_engine='python-re' if needed
__post_init__ now runs after validation (R23) — any side effects in __post_init__ that depended on pre-validation state may break

name: migrate
detail: Super migrates each planned file in one pass, in parallel
